title: Command Injection via Subprocess with User Input
description: The application at `app.py:12` utilizes `subprocess.run` with `shell=True`, and a user-provided value is directly incorporated into the command executed. This creates a critical command injection vulnerability (CWE-078), allowing an attacker to execute arbitrary shell commands on the system. Both Semgrep and CodeQL reported high-severity findings confirming this issue.
